summary: Verification-only phase: re-proves, under one dedicated 87-test suite, that every observation-only integration completed across 109B (INT-001) and 109C (INT-002 through INT-004) still holds its guarantees, without touching any file under src/pcae/. Per-integration: broker consulted, decision discarded, output/exit-code/control-flow/lifecycle/governance unchanged, re-verified for all four IDs across ALLOW, DENY, HUMAN_REVIEW, None, and raised-exception broker responses. Compatibility re-verified against 107B (INV-001..010, COMP-001..010 unchanged), 107C (NG-001..025 unchanged), 108A-108D (12 policy rules, 10 components, AST-import isolation, lifecycle modules never import the broker directly), 108E (.githooks/pre-push unchanged), and 109A (design doc and all prior 109-series phase docs still present) -- no architectural drift. Isolation reconfirmed: every decision reports implementation_status == execution_unavailable unconditionally; PermissionBroker.evaluate() has zero filesystem side effects; integrated commands contain no write-capable calls. Fail-safe behavior verified for every broker response specified, including two not previously exercised: a malformed PolicyRule result sanitizes to fail-closed DENY (108C's _sanitize_result(), re-confirmed unmodified), and an empty policy registry fails closed to DENY (_compose()'s documented behavior, unmodified) -- command output/exit code unchanged in both cases. Five malformed-object return shapes verified not to change command output either. Integration ID registry verified unique, documented, correctly mapped, and referenced by this phase's own test suite; unregistered IDs confirmed to return None. Updated safety case confirms observation cannot accidentally become enforcement, cannot bypass governance, and remains fully reversible. Added docs/PHASE_109_OBSERVATION_INTEGRATION_VERIFICATION.md. 87 new tests. Focused integration group (973), governance/autonomy group (572), and release/lifecycle regression group (197) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline). No group required a sequential fallback.
